operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of the account's **refund receipts**, most recent first.

The list supports the same rich filtering as the invoices list (applied to refund-receipt documents) through the query parameters below. Each item is returned under a `RefundReceipt` member; see **GET Single Refund Receipt** for the full field reference.

Requires permission to view invoices/refund receipts. A non-owner without all-invoices access sees only refund receipts they created.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format extension, e.g. `.json`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to the list default (20).

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Filter by client id.

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.description: Filter by client type (individual or business).

parameters.name: no
parameters.description: Filter by refund-receipt number (partial match).

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Return refund receipts that contain a matching item.

parameters.name: currency_code
parameters.description: Filter by currency code (for example, USD).

parameters.name: payment_status
parameters.description: Filter by payment status. Pass `-1` to return only draft refund receipts.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tag id(s).

parameters.name: source_type
parameters.description: Filter by the source document type. Use together with source_id.

parameters.name: source_id
parameters.description: Filter by the source document id. Use together with source_type.

parameters.name: work_order_id
parameters.description: Filter by linked work-order id. Available with the Work Orders plugin.

parameters.name: order_source_id
parameters.description: Filter by order source id.

parameters.name: custom_field
parameters.description: Filter by a custom-field value. Combine with custom_field_label to target a specific field.

parameters.name: custom_field_label
parameters.description: Custom-field label to match together with custom_field.

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.description: Filter by the staff member who created the refund receipt. Available with the Staff plugin and view-all permission.

parameters.name: sales_person_id
parameters.description: Filter by sales person. Available with the Staff plugin and view-all permission.

parameters.name: summary_total_from
parameters.description: Return refund receipts whose total is at least this amount.

parameters.name: summary_total_to
parameters.description: Return refund receipts whose total is at most this amount.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Refund-receipt date range start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Refund-receipt date range end (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Created-date range start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: created_to
parameters.description: Created-date range end (YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: A paginated list of refund receipts.

data.description: Refund receipts, most recent first. Each item carries a `RefundReceipt` member with the refund-receipt header and its client.

RefundReceipt.description: Refund-receipt header. See GET Single Refund Receipt for the full field reference.

prev.description: URL of the previous page, or null on the first page.

next.description: URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to view refund receipts.
